title: Permits over-the-counter purchase of ivermectin and hydroxychloroquine tablets without a prescription

abstracts.abstract:
SB 1086 - Under this act, ivermectin and hydroxychloroquine tablets suitable for human use may be sold or purchased as over-the-counter medications in Missouri without a prescription or consultation with a pharmacist or other health care professional.

	This act is identical to SB 1275 (2026), substantially similar to SB 1489 (2026), SB 744 (2025), and HB 2581 (2024), and similar to provisions in the truly agreed to and finally passed SS/SCS/HCS/HB 2372 (2026), the truly agreed to and finally passed HCS/SS/SCS/SB 878 (2026), and HCS/HB 3009 (2026).
SARAH HASKINS
